title: Concrete Legal Interrogation to Legal Effect v0.14 compiler bridge
summary: Legal Interrogation dev6 implements the previously abstract compile seam against the real Legal Effect v0.14 / legal.effect/0.10 compiler contract. It preserves verifier-issued source/provision evidence, maps only reviewed active propositions, and remains non-authoritative until LegalRuleCompiler certifies and seals the generation.
invariants: A Legal Interrogation handoff is not source verification and cannot set LegalSourceIdentity verification state.
The bridge requires LegalSourceIdentity~cryptographicallyVerified; an asserted VERIFIED token without verifier-issued evidence is rejected.
Every LegalProvisionReference uses the exact source identity expressionId and is verified through LegalSourceVerifier before proposal admission.
Supported propositions may map to LegalNorm, but conditions and exceptions cross the bridge only as already-structured LegalPredicate objects; free-text predicate guessing is forbidden.
LegalCompileProposal carries verified provision references. The bridge does not preattach evidence to LegalNorm because Legal Effect rejects proposal evidence outside the compiler-controlled path.
LegalInterrogationLegalEffectCompilation remains non-authoritative until LegalRuleCompiler~compile succeeds.
Only LegalRuleCompiler may issue the compilation certificate that makes the sealed LegalRuleGeneration publicationEligible.

provenance.claim: Real v0.14 compiler validates verified source/provision identities, expression identity, evidence references and proposal shapes; compiler certification is the publication-eligibility boundary.
Dev6 implements the concrete adapter/mapper/non-authoritative compilation wrapper against the v0.14 public compiler classes.
Real r13196 qualification verifies source and provision evidence, compiler certification/publication eligibility, norm mapping, and rejection of asserted-only source verification.
